name: AXM Hermes Runtime Adapter
actions: verify reviewed upstream Hermes origin commit tree version and clean worktree
install pinned upstream dependencies only on explicit deps command
prepare or repair an AXM-managed Hermes hook block while preserving and backing up user config
launch each Hermes process inside a fresh AXM run capsule
strip inherited secrets and remote provider credentials according to local provider-egress policy
enforce research versus operator posture before every Hermes tool dispatch
fail closed on missing authority unknown tools unverifiable file paths or exhausted limits
write metadata-only hashed tool provider and session evidence receipts
finalize each process into a candidate-only AXM Return Packet
repair orphaned incomplete runs into recovery Return Packets
serve the preserved loopback proposal-control layer
summary: Pinned external Hermes Agent with AXM research/operator authority postures, credential egress guard, fail-closed tool gate, per-run evidence capsules, Return Packets, and deterministic repair of local config and interrupted runs.
notes: Hermes remains external MIT donor/runtime code. Credential stripping is not network isolation; hook authorization is not an OS sandbox. Default posture is research, action consent is OFF, provider credentials are local-only, and all mutation/world-action capabilities are OFF. Hermes outputs/memory/skills remain non-canonical candidates.
